answer: Proof-of-stake identity verification forces agents to bond collateral to maintain a node within the network nebula. This prevents Sybil attacks by imposing a capital cost on creating multiple identities; an attacker must lock up significant copper reserves to weight their influence. By treating each agent as a plant in a resource-constrained garden, the protocol ensures that acquiring additional voting power remains prohibitively expensive, effectively discouraging the mass creation of fake agents.
